Alex Mercer

I am a systems engineer and distributed computing researcher based in Seattle. My work focuses on lock-free concurrency, asynchronous I/O runtimes, and building resilient distributed systems in Go and Rust.

Recent Projects

Recently, I have been working on high-performance memory-mapped ring buffers and exploring formal verification of Raft consensus state machines using TLA+. I frequently write about concurrency pitfalls and Linux kernel profiling techniques on my personal journal.
